summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, announcing a board-approved one-for-ten reverse share split of its ordinary shares, effective upon Nasdaq open on September 4, 2026. This follows shareholder approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting on August 18, 2026. The split aims to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. No fractional shares will be issued; fractions will be rounded to the nearest whole share. Outstanding warrants and options will have their exercise prices and share numbers proportionally adjusted. The new CUSIP is M2R51X124. Shareholders need not take action; physical certificate holders will receive instructions from the transfer agent. What to watch: post-split trading price and Nasdaq compliance.
